import json,pathlib,sys,traceback,unittest
assert not list(pathlib.Path('/dev').glob('nvidia*'))
import torch
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
class CapturedErrors(unittest.TextTestResult):
 def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):super().__init__(*args,**kwargs);self.captured=[]
 def addError(self,test,err):
  self.captured.append((test._testMethodName,err[0],err[1].args,traceback.format_exception(*err)))
  super().addError(test,err)
def verify_expected_failures(result):
 expected={
  'test_marlin_empty_g_idx_round_trip':(KeyError,('w13_weight_g_idx',)),
  'test_persistent_attention_scale_round_trip':(ValueError,("Missing keys ('_k_scale',) in loaded state!",)),
  'test_same_parameter_module_alias_round_trip':(ValueError,("Missing keys ('mla_attn.fused_qkv_a_proj.weight',) in loaded state!",)),
 }
 assert result.testsRun==3 and len(result.errors)==3 and not result.failures and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures and not result.unexpectedSuccesses
 assert len(result.captured)==3 and {row[0] for row in result.captured}==set(expected)
 for name,kind,args,trace in result.captured:
  assert kind is expected[name][0] and args==expected[name][1], 'unexpected baseline failure class/key'
 assert not result.wasSuccessful()
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('/work/sllm_store/tests/python',pattern='test_vllm_loader_state.py')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=sys.stderr,verbosity=2,resultclass=CapturedErrors).run(suite)
print(json.dumps({'event':'LOADER_CONTRACT_BASELINE_ERRORS','tests_run':result.testsRun,'errors':len(result.errors),'failures':len(result.failures),'captured':[{'test_method':name,'exception_type':kind.__module__+'.'+kind.__qualname__,'args':args,'traceback':''.join(trace)} for name,kind,args,trace in result.captured]},default=str),flush=True)
verify_expected_failures(result)
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized() and not list(pathlib.Path('/dev').glob('nvidia*'))
print('EXPECTED_LOADER_CONTRACT_FAILURES_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
